declared.source: model source via stage 1 AST extraction; never inferred from kernel shapes, which only ever show this rank's slice

expert_parallelism.residency_evidence: leading dim of the stacked expert weight in 12 GroupedMatmul kernel(s), e.g. op 167
expert_parallelism.identity_note: The capture does not record ep_rank, so the resident expert COUNT is known but their global indices are not. Rank r owns [r*local, (r+1)*local); pass --ep-rank to resolve identities.
expert_parallelism.note: 16 of 256 routed experts have weights on the profiled rank. The other 240 execute elsewhere and are declared, not observed.

measurability.reason: The resident routed experts execute as one GroupedMatmul over a stacked weight, with group_list giving per-expert token counts. The profiler reports a single duration for that kernel. Dividing it by token share would produce per-expert numbers the hardware never measured.
measurability.what_would_be_needed: Per-expert kernels (unfused MoE), or a profiler that emits per-group timing inside GroupedMatmul.
